hook_text: A giant compass rose painted on a netball court. Can you point north-west without looking?
clip_script: Kimberley, the first week of Grade 6. On the netball court: a giant compass rose. The globe is a round model of the Earth. The North Pole is at the top, the South Pole at the bottom, and the equator runs around the middle, cutting the Earth into two hemispheres. South Africa is in the Southern Hemisphere. Eight compass points: north, north-east, east, south-east, south, south-west, west, north-west. Every direction is measured from a fixed point. Ready for Grade 6 maps!
visual_style: Whiteboard netball court with a compass rose drawing itself, then a spinning globe with the equator and poles labelled.
mood: Fresh and energetic, like the first week of a new school year.
pacing: Quick start on the court, steady revision of the globe, then fast-fire compass points.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find north from your own front door.
